reading.body:
Equinix DC17 is one of 15 facilities across the Washington DC metro region, where Equinix operates the largest single-metro presence in its global portfolio. The metro region as a whole serves as North America's primary peering point and a major gateway to Europe. DC17's own capacity and specifications are not published; Equinix's individual page for this facility returns a 404 error.

Virginia has 326 mapped data center facilities, of which only 23 operators have published power capacity figures totaling 1,375 megawatts. DC17 does not appear among the 23 facilities with published capacity in the state.

Without published power or floor space figures for DC17 itself, the facility cannot be directly assessed for AI workload potential. Its position within Equinix's largest US metro campus, and that metro region's centrality to North American peering and transatlantic traffic, places it in infrastructure that matters to cloud and content operators. Whether it matters to AI scaling depends on capacity and power availability that Equinix has not disclosed.
